notes.title: Demo v0.0.5
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210660/cda734cffb8fa8483552f83338ec4f2a3a2ee198.png"][/img][/p][p]Compared to the last Demo-Update this one is much more sustantial.[/p][list][*][p]The battle system has been revised with a semi-hitstop to give the player better readability of what's going on[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard controls have been added ( WASD + N + M )[/p][/*][*][p]Chickens now interact with the player[/p][/*][*][p]You can now bounce around on beds[/p][/*][*][p]Reqorked pushing blocks from the ground up ( I am aware it sitll has some bugs )[/p][/*][*][p]A new feature has been added that gives little bonuses for exploring[/p][/*][*][p]Transparancy feature has been added for elements that cover Yve[/p][/*][*][p]Water now interacts with the player[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment item icons have been reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Trap music has been added[/p][/*][*][p]The final trap should be fixed for good. No more having to repeat that room after the traps are active[/p][/*][*][p]Death now leads to Exit-screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a button colored a door[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some dialogue typos[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision for shop-items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that enemies were showing numbers even when dead[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound-effects to many interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so you actually have to jump on top of buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some geometry problems I was aware of[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collision so you can't open chests from a level lower[/p][/*][/list][p]That was a lot of work, but I want to thank everyone who provided valuable feedback. Of course I also developed more content for the game itself, a lot of these improvements come from the larger game I work on. I still want to make sure the Demo is always as polished as possible.
Apologies for the lack of a settings menu. The sound is too loud and I am sure people want to reconfigure the keyboard keys. I want to implement settings in the future![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.3
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Powder is now disabled
[*] Dungeon final trap fixed
[*] Character-shadows are now much stronger
[*] Decreased Yve's collision size for better quality behaviour
[*] Namebox bigger and can now contain longer names
[*] Weird Pucktown sign fixed ( I know this was fun! I'll give it some thought )
[*] Fixed Pucktown house collision
[*] Fixed texture flicker near a house
[*] Dungeon1: removed a floor panel, these are used to mark rewards
[*] Doublegate near dungeon 1 now lights up. Collision fixes to close holes.
[*] Trap where you pass from one dungeon to the other is now fairer
[*] New boots icon added
[*] Enemies don't show damage numbers at 0 health anymore
[*] Pucktown: Fixed hole you could role into near the creek
[/olist]
